gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs las gsang ba 'dus pa thabs chen yab kyi lung rgyud
item.coloph: gsang ba'i lung chen rgyud sde nyid bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa yis bdud 'dul sngags kyi gling chen du dran pa nam mkha' nyid la gdams snying bzhin gces spras nyams su blangs bod du bstan pa 'phel 'grib dus dran pas be rol (bI rA+or) gtad cing gnang bai ros rong chen tsha ba rdzong rin chen 'bar ba'i brag la sbas yum sras lnga la gnyer du bcol las can gcig dang 'phrad par smon sa ma ya gter rgya dam rgya uya rgya rgya rgya rgya u la ag tham rgya8rgya rgya zhes pa'i gsang 'dus lung chen 'di gsang sngags gling pas tsha rong kha ba dkar po'i gnas nas zag (zab) gter rin po che spyan drangs shing phyis su shar rdza'i rtogs ldan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang grogs dbang mo dang mchog sprul g.yung drung sogs skyes bu dam pa du mas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas lo bcu gsum gyi bka' rgya grol ba dang dus 'dzoms par phab pa'i dge des gshen bstan rin po che phyogs brgyar rgyal ba'i rgyu ru gyur par shog gcig gu//
